DecimalWire.description:
Exact decimal encoded only as a JSON string.

Restoration routes through [`crate::decimal::parse_decimal`], the single
exact text-admission rule: JSON numbers, malformed text and inexact values
are rejected rather than rounded. Serialization writes canonical
fixed-point text with trailing zeros removed and signed zero normalized
(`"1.5"`, `"0"`), never scientific notation.

description: Named cumulative-PD and LGD assumptions with an exact scenario probability.

id.description: Nonempty scenario identifier, distinct within one scenario set.

lgd_override.description: Elected nonnegative loss fraction in [0, 1] for this scenario.

pd_schedule.description:
Ordered year and cumulative PD observations from valuation.
Omit when the scenario evidence is missing. An explicitly present
schedule must cover the measurement horizon.

weight.description: Exact decimal probability in [0, 1]; the admitted set sums to one.

title: EclScenario
